facts.fact: Somali civil society (SONSA) issued a position on 20 July 2026 calling on the federal government, the NCA and the Data Protection Authority to sign the Malabo Convention, ratify it and deposit the instrument, so that Somalia can become a State Party; the document says Somalia is not yet one.

The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 shows Somalia (no. 45) with no date of signature, ratification or deposit for the Malabo Convention, which it says entered into force on 8 June 2023 and has 21 signatures and 20 ratifications among 55 states.
